en: My name is Luis, nice to meet you.
I'm from Peru, and you?
How do you spell your last name?
I live in a small town near Lima.
es: Vivo en un pueblo pequeño cerca de Lima.

en: She works as a nurse in a hospital.
es: Ella trabaja como enfermera en un hospital.

en: I'm learning English because I want to travel.
es: Estoy aprendiendo inglés porque quiero viajar.

en: Where are you from?
I like playing soccer with my friends.
es: Me gusta jugar fútbol con mis amigos.

en: Could you speak a little slower, please?
es: ¿Podrías hablar un poco más despacio, por favor?

en: I met my best friend three years ago.
es: Conocí a mi mejor amigo hace tres años.

en: I start work at eight in the morning.
es: Empiezo a trabajar a las ocho de la mañana.

en: Do you have a minute to talk?
My boss is out of the office today.
es: Mi jefe no está en la oficina hoy.

en: I have a meeting at three o'clock.
es: Tengo una reunión a las tres.

en: Can you send me the report by Friday?
es: ¿Puedes enviarme el informe para el viernes?

en: I'm working on a new project right now.
es: Estoy trabajando en un proyecto nuevo ahora mismo.

en: We finished the presentation yesterday.
I'll call the client this afternoon.
Let's take a short break.
I need some help with this email.
I'd like a glass of water, please.
es: Quisiera un vaso de agua, por favor.

en: What do you recommend?
Can we have the menu, please?
es: ¿Nos puede traer la carta, por favor?

en: I don't eat meat.
The soup is too hot.
We would like to order now.
Does this dish have nuts?
Could we have the bill, please?
es: ¿Nos podría traer la cuenta, por favor?

en: I ate too much yesterday.
Breakfast is my favorite meal of the day.
es: El desayuno es mi comida favorita del día.

en: Where is the check-in desk?
My flight leaves at six thirty.
es: Mi vuelo sale a las seis y media.

en: Here is my passport and my ticket.
es: Aquí están mi pasaporte y mi boleto.

en: Is this the gate for Miami?
I'm going to visit my cousin in Chicago.
es: Voy a visitar a mi primo en Chicago.

en: I have only one suitcase.
How long is the flight?
The plane landed ten minutes ago.
es: El avión aterrizó hace diez minutos.

en: Excuse me, is this seat taken?
I'd like a window seat, please.
es: Quisiera un asiento de ventana, por favor.

en: How much is this jacket?
Do you have this in a smaller size?
es: ¿Tiene esto en una talla más pequeña?

en: I'm just looking, thank you.
It's too expensive for me.
Can I try it on?
I'll take it.
Do you accept credit cards?
Is there a discount today?
I bought these shoes last week.
es: Compré estos zapatos la semana pasada.

en: Could I get a receipt, please?
es: ¿Me podría dar un recibo, por favor?

en: I have a headache and a sore throat.
es: Tengo dolor de cabeza y dolor de garganta.

en: I don't feel well today.
When did the pain start?
I need to see a doctor.
Take this medicine twice a day.
es: Tome esta medicina dos veces al día.

en: You should drink a lot of water.
I'm allergic to penicillin.
My back hurts when I sit for a long time.
es: Me duele la espalda cuando me siento por mucho tiempo.

en: Do you have a fever?
I feel much better today.
Excuse me, where is the bank?
Turn left at the corner.
es: Gire a la izquierda en la esquina.

en: Go straight for two blocks.
Is it far from here?
The station is next to the park.
es: La estación está al lado del parque.

en: How do I get to the museum?
It's about ten minutes on foot.
es: Está a unos diez minutos a pie.

en: Is there a pharmacy near here?
The bus stop is across from the bank.
es: La parada de autobús está frente al banco.

en: I'm lost. Can you help me?
I live with my parents and my sister.
es: Vivo con mis padres y mi hermana.

en: There are three bedrooms in our house.
es: Hay tres dormitorios en nuestra casa.

en: My mother is cooking dinner now.
es: Mi madre está preparando la cena ahora.

en: We eat dinner at seven every night.
es: Cenamos a las siete todas las noches.

en: I wake up at six and take a shower.
es: Me despierto a las seis y me ducho.

en: My brother doesn't like to wash the dishes.
es: A mi hermano no le gusta lavar los platos.

en: Please turn off the lights.
Our apartment is on the second floor.
es: Nuestro departamento está en el segundo piso.

en: Yesterday I cleaned the whole house.
My grandmother lives next door.
es: Mi abuela vive en la casa de al lado.

en: What do you do on weekends?
It's sunny and warm today.
It's going to rain tomorrow.
I usually watch movies on Saturday.
Let's go to the beach this weekend.
es: Vayamos a la playa este fin de semana.

en: We played soccer in the park yesterday.
es: Jugamos fútbol en el parque ayer.

en: I'm reading a very good book.
es: Estoy leyendo un libro muy bueno.

en: Do you want to come with us?
It was cold and windy last night.
es: Anoche hizo frío y hubo viento.

en: I love going for a walk after dinner.
es: Me encanta salir a caminar después de cenar.

en: I have a reservation under the name Rivera.
es: Tengo una reserva a nombre de Rivera.

en: What time is breakfast?
Is there Wi-Fi in the room?
Could I have a late checkout, please?
es: ¿Podría tener una salida tardía, por favor?

en: The air conditioner doesn't work.
I'd like a room for two nights.
es: Quisiera una habitación para dos noches.

en: Where can I leave my luggage?
The room is clean and quiet.
es: La habitación está limpia y tranquila.

en: Can you call a taxi for me?
We are staying here until Sunday.
es: Nos estamos quedando aquí hasta el domingo.
